message.content:
The illustration depicts four men against a stylized cityscape silhouette under a gradient sky transitioning from white to pink to blue. The magazine title "TEMPO" is centered in large red letters at the top, above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Other text includes "LELAKI MISTERIUS DI DEPAN RUMAH NOVEL BASWEDAN", "BABAK BARU PRODUSER FILM VS BIOSKOP", and "BEREBUT PEMILIH MUSLIM" in large bold black letters at the bottom left. A date "17-23 APRIL 2017", price "RP 45.000", and a barcode appear at the bottom right.

The four men are arranged in a horizontal row. On the far left, a man with glasses and a white cap wears a white shirt and a blue scarf, holding his hands in front of him. Next to him, a man in a red plaid shirt holds a white cylindrical cap above the head of the man to his right. The third man, with a mustache and a white coat over a plaid shirt, holds a black serrated rectangle to his chin. The fourth man on the right wears a white turban and a long white coat over grey trousers, adjusting his headwear with both hands. All have simplified, cartoonish features. They stand in front of a blue city skyline with recognizable skyscraper shapes.
